preconditions.description: The input num must be an integer.
The input num must be non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '0123456789-' for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: The output string must contain only digits and dashes.

postconditions.expression: all(int(c) % 2 == 0 or return_value[i-1] != '-' for i, c in enumerate(return_value) if c.isdigit() and i > 0)
postconditions.description: Dashes must not appear between two odd digits.

postconditions.expression: all(int(c) % 2 != 0 or return_value[i-1] != '-' for i, c in enumerate(return_value) if c.isdigit() and i > 0)
postconditions.description: Dashes must not appear between an odd and an even digit.

postconditions.expression: all(int(c) % 2 != 0 or return_value[i+1] != '-' for i, c in enumerate(return_value) if c.isdigit() and i < len(return_value) - 1)
postconditions.description: Dashes must not appear between an even and an odd digit.

postconditions.expression: all(int(c) % 2 == 0 or return_value[i+1] != '-' for i, c in enumerate(return_value) if c.isdigit() and i < len(return_value) - 1)
postconditions.description: Dashes must not appear between two even digits.
